dedupe_keys.name: py school match school assignment algorithms

description: Py-school-match is a Python package with matching algorithms for assigning students to schools. The JOSS paper describes comparing fairness and efficiency under quotas, preferences and special rules; the own README lists trading-cycle and deferred-acceptance methods. Spatial coverage is the school system and service area supplied by a user, and temporal coverage is an admission round, not a historical dataset. The public repository reports GPL-3.0. A school-capacity modeller could compare catchment and assignment policies after demographic change or facility disruption. A caveat is that the algorithm does not estimate travel times, school quality or how preferences would change after an intervention. Fairness depends on policy definitions and the actual applicant data. The code is a decision model, not an adopted placement rule for any city. No directly related catalogue record was established. The article and own repository were read without processing student records or running a match. The outputs can be compared within a school-service simulation to test capacity and travel consequences under alternative admission rules.
name: Py-school-match school assignment algorithms
notes: G5 G5-0768. Software checked through metadata and documentation, without installation or execution. Geographic scope follows the documented application or software portability; it does not imply validation throughout that area.
